text: Looked at it. The engine already has per-game safeguards: at most 2 bets / $100 per side, one extra line per team per game, and a 10% of wallet cap per game, but they only count the ENGINE's own orders. The engine placed one Temple bet (-19.5, 86 contracts at 12:49 ET); the -18.5 and -17.5 in your photo (12:54) did not come from the engine (not in its ledger or bid desk), so they came from another path (the phone's bid/auto desk or by hand) that doesn't see the engine's. Fix I'll build (TCL91): every path checks the whole account's exposure on that game (read from Novig's open positions) against one cap, so correlated lines like -17.5/-18.5/-19.5 can't stack up. Queued right after this release.
